lines.t: I walked the paths of pride and vanity,
Lost in the noise of empty glory,
Chasing shadows, tangled in the lies,
Yet deep inside, I longed for holy skies.
Come out of the world, come back to Me,
Abide in My doctrine, set your spirit free,
I’ll restore the broken, make all things new,
My Kingdom is coming, and I’m calling you.
Wolves surround me, voices filled with blame,
But I’ll not return evil for evil’s name,
Through tears and trials, I’ll walk this narrow road,
Forgiving, holding fast to the hope bestowed.
Come out of the world, come back to Me,
Abide in My doctrine, set your spirit free,
I’ll restore the broken, make all things new,
My Kingdom is coming, and I’m calling you.
A day of thick clouds, then light will break,
Sorrow will vanish, no more hearts to ache,
Restored in love, in the fullness of grace,
Forever with Him, in His holy place.
Come out of the world, come back to Me,
Abide in My doctrine, set your spirit free,
I’ll restore the broken, make all things new,
My Kingdom is coming, and I’m calling you.
